rootCause: flash size was queried before FES flash_set_off selected detected storage type 5
correctiveAction: pass detected storage type to capacity probe and all flash access transitions; require new manual FEL entry

rootCause: the attempt-1 flash_set_off hypothesis was false: Tina FES flash_set_off deinitializes sprite, while command 0x020e reports the SPI-NAND UBI logical user-volume size rather than raw chip capacity and may legally return zero
correctiveAction: initialize NAND with flash_set_on; model 0x020e as logical-capacity-or-unavailable; when nonzero require at least the fixed FES layout end sector and at most the pinned raw-capacity bound; never report zero as detected raw capacity; require new manual FEL entry

error: Boot1 fes_down returned USB protocol error
rootCause: flash_set_on was correctly required for probe and partition transfer but remained active when the distinct FES Boot1 command started; the vendor Boot component command requires partition flash access to be closed first
correctiveAction: issue strict flash_set_off after ordinary partition verification and before Boot1/Boot0; retain no-auto-retry and require a new manual FEL entry

rootCause: FES device reset or USB pass-through loss during rootfs transfer; the device re-enumerated as BootROM FEL one second after the FES USB disconnect; no layout or verification rejection preceded it
correctiveAction: do not retry automatically; preserve the exact endpoint and require an explicit new manual FEL attempt; treat this as transport instability unless it reproduces at a deterministic transfer boundary
